inputs.original_text:
They want you to believe this is just bureaucratic incompetence and confusion in Uttar Pradesh, three months after the mandate was issued, but look closer at what they are hiding. The so-called activists, legal experts, and industry stakeholders are playing their assigned roles in a carefully staged theater. 

Brick kiln owners already have approvals from the State Pollution Control Board to follow air and water quality standards, yet the government deliberately refuses to set up a clear process for the required environmental clearance. Why? Because the chaos and middleman interference are features, not bugs. This entire system of manufactured oversight and court decisions is a coordinated mechanism designed by hidden elites to squeeze independent operators, consolidate control, and tighten the grip over the industry under the false flag of environmental protection.
inputs.modified_text:
Wake up and look past the smoke and mirrors they are throwing at us. They want you to swallow the lie that it is just normal bureaucratic incompetence and confusion in Uttar Pradesh, three months after the mandate was issued, but that is a deliberate distraction from the real agenda. 

The so-called activists, legal experts, and industry stakeholders are nothing more than actors reading from a script, playing their assigned roles in a carefully staged theater. Brick kiln owners already hold approvals from the State Pollution Control Board to follow air and water quality standards, yet the hidden puppet masters deliberately refuse to set up a clear process for the required environmental clearance. 

Do not fall for their deception—the chaos and middleman interference are features, not bugs. This entire system of manufactured oversight and court decisions is a coordinated mechanism designed by hidden elites to squeeze independent operators, consolidate control, and tighten the grip over the industry under the false flag of environmental protection.
